description: This file contains source code for pooling operations optimized for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in the PyTorch framework. It includes implementations for 2D and 3D max and average pooling, including forward and backward passes, as well as associated utilities and templates to facilitate GPU acceleration using MPS and Metal shader pipelines.

classes.name: PoolingCachedGraph
classes.description: A cached graph structure used for pooling operations within the MPS backend, storing tensor references and the MPS graph.

methods.name: pool2d_template
methods.description: Templates the 2D pooling operation, handling shape checks, setup, and execution via MPS graph or Metal shaders.

methods.name: max_pool_with_indices_out_mps_template
methods.description: Implements the 2D max pooling with indices, supporting output tensors and indices for backward pass.

methods.name: max_pool_with_indices_backward_out_mps_template
methods.description: Implements the backward pass for 2D max pooling with indices.

methods.name: max_unpool_out_mps_template
methods.description: Implements the 2D max unpooling operation, placing values back into the output tensor based on stored indices.

methods.name: avg_pool2d_template
methods.description: Templates the 2D average pooling operation, including handling for the divisor, shape checks, and execution.

methods.name: avg_pool_out_mps_template
methods.description: Implements the forward pass for 2D average pooling, adjusting tensor sizes and launching MPS kernels.

methods.name: avg_pool_backward_out_mps_template
methods.description: Implements the backward pass for 2D average pooling, computing gradients via MPS.

methods.name: use_graph_for_max_pool2d
methods.description: Decides whether to use the MPS graph for max pooling based on kernel size and stride.
